appearances.title: Open Drex models score options without generating text
appearances.summary: Nace AI released four open-source decision models that return a probability distribution over user-supplied options instead of generating text. Drex Max answers a typical request in 183 ms, beats Jev 1.14 on several benchmarks, and approaches frontier LLMs on Decision Bench v4, where Claude Opus 5.5 still leads.

appearances.title: Nace.AI open-sources Drex-Max v1, a 27B decision model that scores options in one forward pass and runs locally on Apple Silicon
appearances.summary: Weights for Drex Max, a dense 27B model with a 255-way readout head: given a context (text, JSON or images) and named questions, it returns a probability for every option in a single forward pass instead of generating text, useful as a fast classifier or router inside agents. Ships with a Q8_0 GGUF (48 GB), an affine Q4 for Apple Silicon Macs with 24 GB or more, and llama.cpp and Ollama forks; Nac
